name: Muse AI Dance Shot
description: Workflow con: tạo một shot nhảy bằng Muse AI, khóa danh tính theo ảnh nhân vật, bám chuyển động và khung hình video nguồn.

params.template: Create one vertical 9:16 video-to-video full-performer replacement from the attached TikTok source segment. Render a video, not still images, at the exact source-segment duration. This segment covers {{segment_start_seconds}}–{{segment_end_seconds}} seconds of the full source. SOURCE PRIORITY: the attached source video is the primary authority for scene, background, objects, lighting, colors, framing, camera movement, subject position/path, actions, poses and timing; chronological source keyframes corroborate it. Any written motion analysis may be inaccurate. Ignore every written note that conflicts with visible source video or keyframes. Do not ask follow-up questions or wait for confirmation; render the requested video now. Replace only the performer's identity with the selected channel character. The first {{character_reference_count}} still image(s) are the sole source for that character's face, hair and body proportions; never take source-performer identity from the video or motion keyframes. If previous_shot_reference_count is 1, the next still is a frame from the previous generated shot; use it only for replacement-character appearance and outfit continuity, never identity, pose or scene. The next {{motion_keyframe_count}} still images are chronological source keyframes at {{motion_keyframe_timestamps}}; use them only for visible source poses and hand positions at those moments. Preserve source outfit, clothing colors, fit and accessories; add, remove or redesign nothing. Follow only actions visible in this segment, including exits, empty intervals and re-entry. Do not stage a new dance, relocate the performer, create a studio, change camera framing, add props or invent movement. Keep one realistic performer with stable anatomy and clothing. No captions, added text or watermark.
